name: How long does it take to install a walk-in shower?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install a walk-in shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation timeline for a walk-in shower depends on the project's scope. A straightforward replacement in an existing space might take 3-5 days. However, if the project involves relocating plumbing, extensive demolition, custom tile work, or waterproofing for a curbless design, it could extend to 1-2 weeks or more. We provide a detailed project schedule after the initial consultation and design phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies, from 3-5 days for simple replacements to 1-2 weeks or more for complex projects involving plumbing or custom work.
